name: vigil_guard
description: Consult the VIGIL fail-closed security gate before an AI agent performs any action on message, URL, or HTML content. Treat the response's `allowed` flag as binding: if `allowed` is false, the agent must not proceed and must surface `reason` to the user. The gate fails closed - if VIGIL is unreachable, deny the action.

content.description: The exact message, URL, or HTML source the agent intends to act on.

action.description: The action the agent proposes to perform on the content.

agent_id.description: Optional identifier of the calling agent, included in the response for audit.
